blurb: Guests rent canoes and camping gear or choose partial or complete outfitting packages for canoe trips in the Boundary Waters Canoe Area Wilderness and Quetico Provincial Park. Permits are required for overnight trips and can be reserved through the outfitter. The outfitting includes canoes, camping equipment, food packages, and optional add-ons like fishing gear and shuttle services.
